QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Sieg's Chest
QuestInfo.0: You try opening the chest, but Noctis's power doesn't work on it. Maybe Sieg can explain.
QuestInfo.1: Sieg says a key opens the chest, not godly powers. Relay this info to Aoe.
QuestInfo.2: Aoe was surprised that godly powers weren't the answer.

default.0: Speak with Aoe. He may know something.
